errors.error_description: Declared and used an escaped identifier named after a language keyword (\always_comb) as a signal, which misuses a reserved word as an identifier.
Mixed blocking and non-blocking assignments in the same clocked sequential block by assigning 'count' with a blocking '=' while other registers use non-blocking '<='.
Instantiated a sub-module with a port width mismatch by connecting a 9-bit vector 'status_bus' to an 8-bit input port.
